{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for customers who converted (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Count how many converted customers have customer_age == -1
missing_age_count = (converted_customers['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

# Count total converted customers
total_converted = len(converted_customers)

# Compute the mean age of those with valid age (not -1)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]
mean_age = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all relevant numbers
print(f"Total converted customers: {total_converted}")
print(f"Converted customers with missing age (-1): {missing_age_count}")
print(f"Converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_converted_customers)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age}")"}
